events.title: Pope Gregory XIII Issues Inter gravissimas
events.description: Pope Gregory XIII promulgated the papal bull Inter gravissimas, which reformed the Julian calendar and introduced the Gregorian calendar. The reform dropped 10 days to realign the calendar with the solar year and adjusted the leap year rules.
events.significance: The Gregorian calendar became the most widely used civil calendar in the world, standardizing timekeeping and the calculation of Easter.

events.title: Marbury v. Madison Decided
events.description: The U.S. Supreme Court, led by Chief Justice John Marshall, ruled in Marbury v. Madison that a section of the Judiciary Act of 1789 was unconstitutional. The decision established the principle that courts can strike down laws that conflict with the Constitution.
events.significance: It established judicial review in the United States, a cornerstone of American constitutional law and the separation of powers.

events.title: Birth of Steve Jobs
events.description: Steve Jobs was born in San Francisco, California. He went on to co-found Apple Inc., lead Pixar Animation Studios, and oversee products such as the Macintosh, iPod, iPhone, and iPad.
events.significance: Jobs transformed personal computing, music, mobile communications, and animation, and became one of the most influential figures in modern technology and design.

events.title: Abdication of King Louis-Philippe of France
events.description: Amid the February Revolution in Paris, King Louis-Philippe abdicated and fled to England. The Second Republic was proclaimed shortly afterward.
events.significance: The event ended the July Monarchy, sparked a wave of revolutions across Europe in 1848, and led to Louis-Napoleon Bonaparte's eventual rise to power.

events.title: Russia Launches Full-Scale Invasion of Ukraine
events.description: Russian forces began a large-scale military invasion of Ukraine, attacking from the north, east, and south, including strikes on Kyiv and other major cities.
events.significance: It became the largest military conflict in Europe since World War II, triggering a major refugee crisis, sweeping international sanctions, and a realignment of European security policy.
